title: DeepResearch Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Deep Research Agents
authors_zh: Mingxuan Du, Benfeng Xu, Chiwei Zhu, Xiaorui Wang, Zhendong Mao
paper_type_zh: 深度研究 Agent 的专家任务、适应性 rubric 与引文评测基准
best_for_zh: 研究开放网页深度研究、长报告 Judge 与引用质量评估的读者。
one_line: DeepResearch Bench evaluates PhD-level web research reports with adaptive criteria and citation-quality assessments.
DeepResearch Bench 用博士级研究任务、适应性准则和引文评估，衡量深度研究 Agent 的报告质量与检索能力。
why: It separates report-quality and retrieval-citation evaluation for deep-research agents.
inclusion_reason: DeepResearch Bench makes long-form web research quality inspectable through adaptive expert-oriented criteria.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Deep-research agents autonomously search, retrieve, and synthesise long reports, but previously lacked a unified cross-domain evaluation. Final answers alone miss reasoning and presentation, citation counts encourage link accumulation, and fully human evaluation is expensive for rapidly changing systems.

DeepResearch Bench uses expert-authored PhD-level tasks, reference-based adaptive criteria, and citation-quality evaluation to measure report quality and information retrieval separately.

深度研究 Agent 会自主搜索、检索并综合长报告，但此前缺少跨领域统一评测。仅看最终答案不能评价论证与表达，只看引用数量又会鼓励堆砌链接；完全人工评分成本很高，难以持续比较快速迭代的系统。

DeepResearch Bench 由专家设计博士级任务，提出参考答案驱动的自适应标准和引用质量评价，分别测报告质量与信息检索。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The benchmark releases 100 PhD-level research tasks across 22 fields and collects long reports from multiple systems. Its RACE framework derives task-adaptive criteria from questions and references to assess comprehensiveness, insight, instruction following, and related quality, while a separate framework measures effective citation count and citation accuracy. Public data, code, and leaderboard support deep-research agent comparison and judge calibration.
基准公开 100 个跨 22 领域的博士级研究任务，并收集多系统生成的长报告。其 RACE 框架依据问题和参考答案自适应生成任务级标准，评价 comprehensiveness、insight、instruction following 等质量；另一套指标计算有效引用数和引用准确率。公开数据、代码和榜单可用于深研 Agent 比较和 Judge 校准。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Analyse real needs: Researchers analyse large numbers of real research queries to define a distribution across 22 fields.
  1. Author tasks: PhD-level and senior experts write 100 open tasks and references with controlled difficulty and evaluability.
  1. Generate adaptive criteria: RACE derives fine-grained checks from each question, reference, and report to reduce limitations of fixed rubrics.
  1. Evaluate reports and citations: Report quality, effective citation count, and citation accuracy are scored separately; retrieval time, judge, and system budget must be fixed.

1. 分析真实需求： 研究者分析大量真实研究查询，形成跨 22 领域的任务分布。
  1. 专家编题： 博士和高级专家编写 100 个开放任务及参考材料，控制难度和可评价性。
  1. 生成自适应标准： RACE 根据每题问题、参考答案和模型报告构造细化检查项，减少固定 rubric 覆盖不足。
  1. 评报告与引用： 分别计算报告质量、有效引用数和引用准确率；复现须固定检索时间、Judge 和系统预算。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The initial leaderboard places Gemini 2.5 Pro Deep Research first on overall RACE quality, while subsequent public results reveal strong trade-offs among report quality, citation quantity, and citation accuracy. Adaptive criteria align well with human judgments, but depend on references and a judge-generated standard, and dynamic web content and model updates make the leaderboard time-dependent.
论文初始榜单显示，Gemini 2.5 Pro Deep Research 在总体 RACE 质量上领先；公开项目后续结果也显示不同 Agent 在质量、引用数量与准确率之间存在明显权衡。自适应标准与人类判断具有较强一致性，但它依赖参考答案与 Judge 生成标准，动态网页和模型更新会使榜单随时间变化。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier deep-research evaluation used small-scale holistic human ratings or fixed answers. DeepResearch Bench combines cross-domain PhD tasks, reference-driven adaptive criteria, and citation evaluation so each task receives suitable checks. The novelty is evaluating both report quality and evidence collection rather than building a new search agent.
早期深研评测多用少量人工总分或固定答案。DeepResearch Bench 将跨域博士任务、参考驱动的自适应标准与引用评价组合，使不同任务可以生成适合自身的检查项。新意是同时评价“报告写得怎样”和“证据找得怎样”，而不是仅建立新搜索 Agent。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: Adaptive criteria are model-generated and may be biased by the evaluated report or omit expert priorities.
  1. Limitation 2: Web pages and citations change, so historical scores require run dates.
  1. Limitation 3: One hundred broad tasks provide shallow coverage per field and cannot yield reliable field-level rankings.

1. 局限1： 自适应标准由模型生成，可能对被评报告产生偏置或遗漏专家关注点。
  1. 局限2： 网页和引用会变化，历史分数需绑定运行日期。
  1. 局限3： 100 个任务覆盖广但每个领域较浅，不能形成领域级可靠排名。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: Compare deep-research agents by reporting RACE and citation metrics separately.
  1. Use case 2: Use public reports and human annotations to calibrate adaptive judges.
  1. Use case 3: For real-time news or private sources, rebuild references and evidence snapshots.

1. 使用场景1： 比较深研 Agent 的报告质量和引用行为，并分别报告 RACE 与 citation 指标。
  1. 使用场景2： 用公开报告和人工标注校准自适应 Judge。
  1. 使用场景3： 对实时新闻或私有研究源应重新构建参考和证据快照。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: Evaluate deep-research reports and citations with 100 PhD-level tasks.
  2. Method: Query analysis, expert tasks, RACE adaptive criteria, and citation evaluation.
  3. Data: Tasks, references, reports, and code across 22 fields are public.
  4. Evidence: Leading systems still trade off report quality and citation metrics.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for deep-research leaderboards; freeze time, judge, and budget.

1. 一句话定位： 用 100 个博士级任务统一评价深研报告和引用。
  2. 方法抓手： 真实查询分析、专家编题、RACE 自适应标准和 citation 评价。
  3. 数据抓手： 22 领域任务、参考、模型报告和评测代码公开。
  4. 证据锚点： 领先系统在质量与引用指标上仍存在权衡。
  5. 复用决定： 适合深研榜单；必须冻结时间、Judge 和预算。
